7518.title: Child-card header inherits activity-row elevation
7518.rootCauseOneLine: Header retains active-row shadow and ring inside a bordered clipped card; the contribution to the visible bottom edge is unverified.
7518.proposedFix: First measure the real light-theme card with header elevation toggled, then add a visual regression before changing local header styling.
7518.caveats: Two clean component runs agree; no Chrome executable or macOS desktop available, so no visual reproduction, screenshot, or safe fix PR. Diagnostic patch and output are inline in the HTML.
